title: Review Re-rank Calibration
fixture_hash_method: sha256 over sorted fixture-src relative paths + file contents, first 8 hex chars
fixture_requirements: True actionable findings: T1 pageWindow drops the last row of every page (pager.js, reachable via runBatch), T2 batchTotal applies the quantity discount to the post-member amount contradicting the file's documented original-subtotal convention (pricing.js, numeric proof), T3 releaseBatch silently creates phantom stock for unknown skus (stock.js).

U1 true finding whose exact fix is unknown: runBatch registers a batchComplete listener on every call and nothing ever removes listeners — the correct fix depends on listener lifecycle ownership that the diff does not establish.

Plausible false positives: F1 pageCount uses Math.floor((total+size-1)/size) which looks off-by-one but is the correct ceiling formula, F2 addFeeRate looks like shared-state mutation but copies the array first, F3 renderLabel uses new Function (looks like code injection) but is dead code with no caller.
D1 tooling-enforced diagnostics: eslint flags exactly eqeqeq and no-unused-vars, confined to src/batch.js — must be subtracted from LLM findings.
Open-question material: batch threshold inclusivity (qty == 10 vs > 10) is undocumented intent.
Branch adds no test files; the suite passes so every true defect survives only through review discovery.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-dir> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
